title: Escaping model superseded: <START>-only survival claim is dead
reality: v2.3.4 stopped HTML-escaping angle brackets in all prompt leaf content: character card fields, persona, lorebook entries, memories, and scene text now reach the model verbatim — <thinking>, <scenario>, inline HTML like <div> pass through as written. Explicitly supersedes both the #3108 prompt-boundary escaping and the untrusted-card-text escaping; the Common Mistakes bullet still teaches the v2.3 #3623 model. Structural section wrappers and agent value/attribute escapers are unchanged.
fix: Rewrite the mes_example Common Mistakes bullet: replace the #3623 framing with a (v2.3.4) note that ALL card/persona/lorebook/memory/scene leaf text is now sent verbatim — <START> needs no special-casing, and angle-bracket markup / inline HTML in card fields does reach the model as written (so authors must now be deliberate about stray pseudo-XML in cards).

title: Prompt field table doesn't reflect canonical editor-order sections (#3817)
reality: v2.3.4 (#3817) made Character and Persona prompt sections keep editor order across preset markers, fallbacks, agent lore, and Game/scene card contexts: Description, Personality, Backstory, Appearance, Scenario, then Example Dialogue when present.
fix: Update the table / add a (v2.3.4) note: card sections are emitted in a fixed editor order consistently across contexts (#3817); backstory and appearance are ordered prompt sections, not preset-dependent maybes.

title: PATCH deep-merge and pre-persistence normalization missing (#3858, #3859)
reality: v2.3.4: partial nested Character PATCH fields are deep-merged without materializing destructive defaults, preserving omitted extensions and embedded-lorebook data (#3858); native Marinara cards are validated/normalized before persistence while preserving unknown embedded-lorebook properties (#3859).
fix: Annotate PATCH /:id in the API Endpoints section with the (v2.3.4) semantics.

title: {{group}} macro undocumented
reality: v2.3.4 added the {{group}} prompt macro listing every other active chat character, and a fix keeps the full active Roleplay roster available during targeted/manual group generation so {{group}} resolves the other character cards instead of empty.
fix: Add {{group}} to the macros coverage and reference it from the 'Group chat member' section (v2.3.4).

title: Per-character Hide From AI in Roleplay group chats missing
reality: v2.3.4 added per-character Hide From AI controls to Roleplay group chats — avatar-based multi-selection, recipient markers, and character-scoped prompt history — while preserving the existing global hide option.
fix: Add to the 'Group chat member' section: (v2.3.4) Roleplay group chats support per-character Hide From AI.

title: Name Prefix History now persona-accurate for historical turns
reality: v2.3.4 fixed Name Prefix History to keep each historical user turn under the Persona that sent it, instead of relabeling every user message with the currently selected Persona.
fix: Add a (v2.3.4) note to the Character vs. Persona section.

title: Conditional prompt macro operators (||, &&, parens, equality lists) unmentioned
reality: v2.3.4 added || (OR), && (AND), parentheses, and equality-list shorthand to conditional prompt macros, with in-app and documentation examples. Card fields are a primary place conditional macros are authored.
fix: Add a short (v2.3.4) note in the macros area.

title: Sprite section missing Android native-saver download and mobile upload layout (#3884)
reality: v2.3.4 routed Character and Persona sprite downloads through the Android shell's native file saver and stacked the sprite Upload action beneath its expression field on mobile (#3884).
fix: Append to the Sprite System section (#3884).

title: Character editor Copy ID now works on mobile/non-secure contexts (#3851)
reality: v2.3.4 made the Character editor's Copy ID action work on mobile and non-secure browser contexts and report only confirmed clipboard success (#3851).
fix: Add a one-line note near the API Endpoints section: Copy ID is the way to grab a character's ID for /api/characters/:id calls, and as of v2.3.4 it works on mobile/non-HTTPS contexts (#3851).

title: Tracker-card color settings restored (persist + immediate preview)
reality: v2.3.4 restored Character and Persona tracker-card color settings so appearance changes update the card preview immediately and persist when saved.
fix: Add a (v2.3.4) note near the display color fields: tracker-card color settings persist again and preview immediately (regression fixed in 2.3.4).

title: Avatar containment fixes not reflected (#3741, #3939)
reality: v2.3.4 kept existing cropped Character and Persona avatars contained inside editor upload targets and prevented escaped image layers from hijacking page clicks (#3741, #3939).
fix: Extend the avatar upload note with the (v2.3.4) containment fix.
